**[P3] Validate execution existence before allocating a worker**

`submit()` creates a daemon worker before `_set_paused()` loads the execution. An unknown ARN raises before worker teardown, leaving the lane registered until runner shutdown. `resume_execution()` has the same problem; distinct unknown ARNs accumulate threads. Validate existence before submission in both methods, or tear down workers on this failure. Extend the unknown-ARN tests to assert that the active worker count remains unchanged.
